result.stdout:
Description:
  Parse, bind, evaluate, run and validate Expressif expressions.

Usage:
  Expressif.Cli [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  parse <expression>     Parse an Expressif expression and display its syntax tree.
  bind <expression>      Bind an Expressif expression and display its bound expression tree.
  evaluate <expression>  Evaluate an Expressif expression.
  run <expression>       Evaluate an Expressif expression for each element of an input sequence.
  validate <expression>  Validate an Expressif expression.
  help <function>        Display documentation for Expressif functions.
  repl                   Start an interactive Expressif session.
  version                Display Expressif CLI and library versions.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Evaluate an Expressif expression.

Usage:
  Expressif.Cli evaluate [<expression>] [options]

Arguments:
  <expression>  Expression to evaluate.

Options:
  -i, --input <input>              Input value passed to the expression.
  -s, --source <source>            Path to a source whose complete row set is passed as one array.
  --scalar                         Treat each source row as a single value. The source must contain exactly one column.
  --source-option <source-option>  Source-specific setting in <name>=<value> form. Repeat to add settings.
  -f, --file <file>                Path to a UTF-8 file containing the expression to evaluate.
  --output-style <Compact|Pretty>  Output style: compact or pretty.
  --pretty                         Shortcut for --output-style pretty.
  --compact                        Shortcut for --output-style compact.
  --indent <indent>                Pretty-output indentation: a space count from 0 to 8, or tab.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Evaluate an Expressif expression for each element of an input sequence.

Usage:
  Expressif.Cli run [<expression>] [options]

Arguments:
  <expression>  Expression to evaluate.

Options:
  -i, --input <input>              Input row passed to the expression. Repeat --input to add rows.
  --batch <batch>                  Enumerable batch input. Each direct element is evaluated as one row.
  -s, --source <source>            Path to a source file returning rows as IEnumerable or IDataReader.
  --format <Csv|Json>              Input format override: csv or json.
  --scalar                         Treat each source row as a single value. The source must contain exactly one column.
  --source-option <source-option>  Source-specific setting in <name>=<value> form. Repeat to add settings.
  -f, --file <file>                Path to a UTF-8 file containing the expression to evaluate.
  --output-style <Compact|Pretty>  Output style: compact or pretty.
  --pretty                         Shortcut for --output-style pretty.
  --compact                        Shortcut for --output-style compact.
  --indent <indent>                Pretty-output indentation: a space count from 0 to 8, or tab.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information

  Validate an Expressif expression.

Usage:
  Expressif.Cli validate [<expression>] [options]

Arguments:
  <expression>  Expression to validate.

Options:
  -f, --file <file>  Path to a UTF-8 file containing the expression to validate.
  --open             Validate the expression as an open expression (default behavior).
  --closed           Validate the expression as a closed expression.
  -?, -h, --help     Show help and usage information
